title: Pepper tart pudding recipe and Alice's love of cooking
summary: Alice describes how pepper tart (a grated sweet-potato pudding) is made, then says she still likes to cook though George objects.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Salicum Serum. Another thing I was wondering about, these folks that you worked for once up at Newcomb College came down to get a recipe of that pudding that they made.
Oh, yes. But the poor man died 15 days after I had seen him. And he never come back to get any more.
What kind of a pudding was that? That hasn't maybe anything to do with our music, but I was interested. I wondered though. Just... The pudding. What was it made out of?

That kind of pudding was pepper tart. Potato...not potato pudding, no. It's just like potato pudding, but it's grated, you know. And you've got to put black pepper in there. A good deal of black pepper. Mm-hmm. Pepper tart, they call it.
Anything else much? Something about sugar to make it sweet, of course.
Sugar and eggs. Mm-hmm. And... Milk. Milk.
Milk.
Milk.
Yeah. Milk.
Milk. Yes, milk. And pas du beurre. No butter.
And do you bake it in an oven or put it on top of the stove?
Yeah, in oven, close, you know.
And then just ordinary potato, white potato, not sweet potato. Sweet potato. Sweet potato. Sweet potato.
Oh, yes, sweet potato.
Oh, I didn't get that.
Sweet potato. Sweet potato. Not Irish potato, no. Sweet potato. Sweet potato. It was called pain patate.
And they had that in Africa then, too. Oh, that's the food. Yes, oh, yes.
Well, how much potato do you use?
Well, it depends on the size you want to make, you know.
Well, George can make it then, too. Yeah, maybe, yeah. I just make it. Some day we'll come over. Yeah, George ought to know how.

Because I used... You know me, I like to cook. Mm-hmm. That's why I fuss with George all the time. George don't want me to cook. He don't want me to do nothing. I'm 94, but I'm not crippled. I look like crippled.
No, you look well. Healthy.
I just can't get about fast like I used to be, what you call, so fast and everything. But now, of course, I have to take my time. I'll balance it like this. Mm-hmm. And do. Makes me so mad.
